items.markdown: The theoretical results that we presented here in the context of reach set approximation are equally valid to approximate compact sets, or the support of probability distributions, in other application domains. Naturally, the computation of the Christoffel function is subject to numerical errors. The impact of such numerical issues will be studied in future work.

This work has been supported by the French government under the “France 2030” program as part of the SystemX Technological Research Institute. This work was conducted as part of the Confiance.AI program, which aims to develop innovative solutions for enhancing the reliability and trustworthiness of AI-based systems.
